parameters.query:
INSERT INTO shopify_webhook_runs (
  webhook_id,
  topic,
  order_id,
  order_number,
  customer_email,
  total_price,
  currency,
  financial_status,
  resend_message_id,
  shopify_note_status,
  shop_domain,
  order_raw,
  webhook_headers,
  processed_at
) VALUES (
  '{{ $('Extract Order Fields').item.json.webhook_id.replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ $('Extract Order Fields').item.json.topic.replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ String($('Extract Order Fields').item.json.order_id).replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ ($('Extract Order Fields').item.json.order_number || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ ($('Extract Order Fields').item.json.customer_email || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  {{ Number($('Extract Order Fields').item.json.total_price) }},
  '{{ $('Extract Order Fields').item.json.currency.replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ $('Extract Order Fields').item.json.financial_status.replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ $('Send Confirmation Email').item.json.id.replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  'success',
  '{{ $('Extract Order Fields').item.json.shop_domain.replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ JSON.stringify($('Extract Order Fields').item.json.order_raw).replace(/'/g, "''") }}'::jsonb,
  '{{ JSON.stringify($('Extract Order Fields').item.json.webhook_headers).replace(/'/g, "''") }}'::jsonb,
  NOW()
)
ON CONFLICT (webhook_id) DO NOTHING;
